params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output '--- runner processes ---'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Runner\.(Listener|Worker)|run\.cmd|runsvc' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'actions-runner|Runner\.Listener' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; Write-Output '--- services/tasks ---'; Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'actions|runner' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'Actions Runner' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status,StartType | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match 'runner|heaven' } | Select-Object TaskName,State,TaskPath | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; Write-Output '--- runner dirs ---'; Get-ChildItem -Path $HOME -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'runner|actions' } | Select-Object FullName,LastWriteTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
